name: Sri Lakshmi Hardware & Paints
description: Family-run hardware counter stocking Taparia tools, Godrej locks and Asian Paints. Contractors and carpenters from nearby layouts buy here on credit.

name: Kanaka Auto Spares
tagline: Genuine spares for every two wheeler
description: Two-wheeler spares shop next to a row of service garages, known for keeping Hero and Honda parts in stock. Mechanics pick up oil and brake shoes here every morning.

name: Kaveri Mobiles
tagline: Chargers, covers and quick screen guard fitting
description: Busy mobile accessories counter that fixes tempered glass while you wait. Also sells earphones, speakers and trimmers.

name: New Bombay Footwear
tagline: Chappals to school shoes under one roof
description: Old footwear store with Bata, Paragon and VKC racks for the whole family. Gets crowded in June when schools reopen.

name: Modern Stationers
description: Stationery shop opposite a government high school, stocking Classmate books, chart paper and exam supplies. Xerox and lamination done at the counter.

name: Balaji Electricals
tagline: Wires, switches and fans at fair rates
description: Electrical goods shop supplying Havells, Anchor and Crompton items to homes and local electricians. Fan repair parts always in stock.

name: Sri Ganesh Plumbing Centre
tagline: Pipes, taps and fittings for every job
description: Plumbing store with Astral and Supreme pipes and a full range of fittings. Plumbers can also be arranged for small repair jobs.

name: Vasavi Textiles
tagline: Sarees, dhotis and readymades for every occasion
description: Textile shop known for cotton sarees, dhotis and blouse materials. Families shop here for festivals and weddings.

name: Annapoorna Home Needs
description: Neighbourhood home needs store with detergents, cleaners, mops and kitchen items. Regular customers order by phone for doorstep delivery.

name: Sri Venkateshwara Hardware Mart
tagline: Hardware and sanitary under one roof
description: Hardware and plumbing store serving building contractors in the new layouts. Stocks fasteners, adhesives, CPVC pipes and bathroom fittings.

name: Raghavendra Electricals & Hardware
tagline: One stop for home repair material
description: General repair material store with wiring, plumbing and hardware items. Popular with electricians and plumbers working in the area.

name: Om Sai Mobile Point
description: Compact mobile accessories shop focused on original chargers, cables and memory cards. Staff help pick the right charger for each phone.

name: Star Electronics
description: Electronics counter that sells speakers, trimmers, irons, remotes and batteries. Replacement DTH and TV remotes are a speciality.

name: Pioneer Auto Parts
tagline: Car and bike spares, lubricants and bulbs
description: Auto parts dealer stocking Castrol, Motul and Bosch products. Also supplies wiper blades and bulbs for cars.

name: Speedway Two Wheeler Spares
description: Two-wheeler accessories shop with helmets, tubes, tyres and bike covers. Free helmet fitting help for new riders.

name: Royal Footwear
tagline: Branded shoes for work and sport
description: Footwear showroom stocking Campus, Sparx, Liberty and Red Chief. Known for formal shoes and sports shoes for students.

name: Janatha Footwear Mart
tagline: Affordable chappals for the whole family
description: Budget footwear shop near the market with Relaxo, Paragon and Walkaroo. Quick turnover of chappals and rain sandals.

name: Sri Durga Shoe Palace
description: Shoe shop that stocks every size of black and white school shoes before the June rush. Also sells socks, polish and gumboots.

name: Sri Krishna Stores
description: Old general store that sells cleaning supplies, notebooks, innerwear and towels. Many families have bought here for three generations.

name: Saraswathi Book & Stationery Centre
tagline: Books, geometry boxes and school bags
description: Stationery and school supplies store near a cluster of schools and PU colleges. School lists are packed in advance during reopening season.

name: Student's Corner
description: Small stationery shop run near a degree college, popular for pens, records and exam pads. Keeps colour and craft items for projects.

name: Vidya Stationers & Xerox
description: Stationery and photocopy shop with A4 paper, files and office supplies. Offices in the area buy staplers and paper in bulk here.

name: Shree Mahalakshmi Silks & Readymades
description: Saree and ethnic wear shop with handloom cottons and silk sarees. Festive season brings the biggest crowds.

name: Classic Menswear
tagline: Shirts, jeans and innerwear for men
description: Menswear shop with shirts, jeans, t-shirts and innerwear brands. Alteration service is available on request.

name: Kids Zone Uniforms & Bags
description: Supplies uniform cloth, sweaters, raincoats and school bags for local schools. Stitching orders are taken in April and May.

name: Sri Manjunatha Plumbing & Sanitary
description: Sanitary store stocking Jaquar, Parryware and Cera fittings. Helps customers choose taps and showers for bathroom renovations.

name: Aqua Sanitary World
description: Plumbing shop with budget PTMT taps and valves plus brass fittings. Plumbers call in orders for delivery to sites.

name: Jyothi Electricals
description: Electrical shop with LED bulbs, battens and switches. Serial lights and decorations fill the counter before Deepavali.

name: Bright Light Electricals
description: Wiring material supplier to contractors with Polycab, Finolex and Havells stock. Offers quick delivery to construction sites.

name: National Electronics
description: Electronics shop selling irons, mixer grinders, kettles and speakers. Also carries batteries and remotes for every brand.

name: Cell World
description: Mobile accessories store with covers and screen guards for most popular models. Fits tempered glass for free with purchase.

name: Mobile Planet
tagline: Power banks, earbuds and smart gadgets
description: Accessories and gadget store stocking boAt, JBL, Ambrane and Xiaomi. Popular with college students for earbuds and power banks.

name: Global Home Centre
description: Home store with mops, buckets, containers and cleaning liquids. Weekend offers on detergent packs.

name: Kalpana Steel & Plastics
tagline: Steel utensils, plastics and pooja items
description: Steel and plasticware shop that also sells diyas, agarbatti and umbrellas in season. A favourite for wedding return gifts.

name: Sri Nandi General Stores
tagline: Daily needs, bulbs and school items
description: Corner general store with cleaning items, basic stationery and bulbs. Open early for morning shoppers.

name: Hanuman Tools & Hardware
description: Tools shop with Bosch power tools, drill bits and fasteners. Carpenters and fabricators are regular customers.

name: Deepak Paints & Hardware
description: Paint and hardware dealer with Asian Paints and Dr. Fixit products. Colour advice given for home repainting jobs.

name: Mahaveer Hardware, Sanitary & Electricals
description: Large general hardware store supplying builders with tools, pipes and wiring material. Bulk orders delivered the same day.

name: Shiva Auto Accessories
description: Accessories shop for car fresheners, wiper blades, bike covers and locks. Fits accessories while you wait.

name: Moto Care Spares
description: Spares counter attached to a bike service centre with oils, filters and cables. Quick service parts for Honda and TVS scooters.

name: Sri Basaveshwara Auto Spares
tagline: Commuter bike parts at wholesale rates
description: Wholesale-cum-retail spares shop supplying small garages across the city. Chain sprocket kits and tubes are fast movers.

name: Sri Ram Footwear
tagline: Sandals and slippers for daily wear
description: Footwear shop with sandals and slippers for men, women and kids. Offers exchange on wrong sizes within a week.

name: Fashion Point Readymades
description: Readymade store with t-shirts, jeans, kurtis and casual footwear. Popular with young shoppers on weekends.

name: City Electronics & Home Appliances
description: Appliance store stocking fans, geysers, irons and mixer grinders. Installation of fans and geysers can be arranged.

name: Digital Zone
description: Gadget shop selling pen drives, mice, calculators, Wi-Fi cameras and phone accessories. Helps set up smart plugs and cameras.

name: Sai Baba Super Bazaar
tagline: Value shopping for the whole family
description: Mini department store with household items, innerwear, towels and chappals. Monthly value deals draw families from nearby areas.

name: Kamadhenu Home Essentials
description: Home essentials shop with laundry, cleaning and mosquito repellent products. Stock of umbrellas and raincoats goes up in the monsoon.

name: Pragathi Electrical & Plumbing Works
description: Shop plus service team for small electrical and plumbing repairs. Keeps MCBs, switches, taps and valves in stock.

name: Supreme Traders
description: Wholesale trader for pipes, wires, fasteners and tools, also selling retail. Serves contractors across the city.
